grounding_contract.context_ids: Server-assigned C1 to C5 in frozen retrieval-v1 order
grounding_contract.answered_output: One or more non-empty claims, each citing at least one supplied context ID
grounding_contract.insufficient_output: No claims and a server-authored insufficient-evidence message
grounding_contract.failure_policy: Reject malformed structures, uncited claims, and unknown citation IDs without repair

decision: Qwen was selected for materially higher answer coverage and context-status accuracy. Mistral was faster and more conservative but incorrectly refused four answerable questions with retrieved evidence.
known_limitations: The development benchmark contains only 18 questions from financial reports.
Qwen answered the one answerable query whose top-five contexts lacked judged evidence instead of refusing.
Three Qwen arithmetic answers were incorrect despite retrieved evidence.
Page-relevant citations do not by themselves prove semantic claim support.
Human claim-support and citation-completeness review remains required before final evaluation.
